Same issue here with deepseek-v4-flash + thinking mode. The error "The reasoning_content in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API" occurs consistently on the second turn — the first assistant reply always succeeds, then every follow-up message fails with a 400 error.

From my investigation, the root cause is:

1. When thinking mode is enabled, DeepSeek API requires ALL assistant messages in the conversation history to include the easoning_content field (even if empty string ""), especially when tool calls are involved.
2. The @ai-sdk/openai-compatible provider's convertToOpenAICompatibleChatMessages() function strips easoning_content from assistant messages on history replay, so when the second user message is sent, the replayed assistant messages from turn 1 lack the required field.
3. The fix in PR #17523/#17529 partially addresses this in ProviderTransform.message, but the root issue in the AI SDK message conversion layer may need a separate fix.

A temporary workaround I found: the error doesn't occur if no tool calls are made in the first turn (simple chat-only messages work). But as soon as tool calls happen (file read/write, etc.), the conversation deadlocks.

Hope this gets prioritized — thinking mode is unusable with agent workflows right now.

opencode on default uses the pro version of gemini, in my case billing was not enabled in AI studio and there was no limits for the pro model use. Switching the model from pro to flash or any other model resolved the error for me.

Thanks for confirming — same findings on my end. The tool-call trigger matches what I traced: tool-call messages replayed from history lack \easoning_content\ because the inner condition in \
ormalizeMessages()\ (transform.ts) skipped them.

I have a working fix that addresses both the entry condition and the narrow inner skip — committed at \ 5b6ad05d\ on branch \ ix/permission-reasoning-truncation\ of my fork (\ kyah3/opencode-fkyah3\). The key changes:

1. Broaden the \hasReasoningContent\ check to fire for any model with \capabilities.reasoning\ (not just models with \interleaved\ configured)
2. Remove the inner condition that filtered by presence of reasoning text / after-last-user / tool-calls — now ALL assistant messages unconditionally get \easoning_content\ injected (empty string if no reasoning text), including string-content messages from old DB format

So far stable across long conversations with heavy tool use. Hope this helps while a proper upstream fix lands.

Same issue here with deepseek-v4-flash + thinking mode. The error is identical — easoning_content not being passed back on conversation continuation.

There's already a working fix from the author of #24104. See fkyah3's comment at https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/24104#issuecomment-4311063617 — they have a commit on their fork ( kyah3/opencode-fkyah3, branch  ix/permission-reasoning-truncation, commit 5b6ad05d) that:

1. Broadens the reasoning content check to fire for any model with capabilities.reasoning
2. Unconditionally injects easoning_content (empty string if no reasoning text) into ALL assistant messages
3. Works stably across long conversations with heavy tool use

In the meantime, a quick workaround is to remove 	hinking: { type: "enabled" } from your model config — the error goes away but you lose thinking mode.

If you want to try the fix now, it's on my fork branch fix/permission-reasoning-truncation at fkyah3/opencode-fkyah3. Commit b5b6ad05d in packages/opencode/src/provider/transform.ts — removes the narrow condition that skipped history-replayed assistant messages.
